articles.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'
articles.description: EU leaders rally around Ukraine's president after new criticism from Donald Trump, who says Zelensky is "more difficult to work with than Putin".

articles.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
articles.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

articles.title: US senators call for investigation into Ukraine's Starlink restrictions
articles.description: Ukraine says temporary speed limits to the Starlink internet network disrupted its battlefield missions.

articles.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
articles.description: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

articles.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
articles.description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

articles.title: Tip-off foiled US teen suspect's plot to attack Hindu temple, police say
articles.description: The alleged plot only failed because the 19-year-old suspect's gun jammed outside the place of worship, say police.

articles.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
articles.description: Ukraine's president says a pause on striking energy sites is over following fresh Russian attacks.

articles.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
articles.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

articles.description: A search and rescue operation is under way in the Black Sea after the latest attack in the area.
